jobs.title: Design / Project / Senior Structural Engineer
jobs.content:
Design / Project / Senior Structural Engineer

Location: Galway, Dublin or Limerick, Ireland
Job Type: Full-time
Sector: Structural Engineering

Overview

We are seeking motivated and talented Structural Engineers at Design Engineer, Project Engineer and Senior Engineer level to join a growing structural engineering team. This is an excellent opportunity to develop technical expertise, work on challenging projects and progress your career within a collaborative and supportive environment.

The role involves the design, analysis, coordination and delivery of a wide range of structural engineering projects, from concept through to construction.

Design structural elements in steel, concrete, timber and masonry in accordance with Eurocodes.
Prepare and review structural calculations using hand calculations and specialist software.
Contribute to complex designs including foundations, transfer structures, torsional beams and flat slabs.
Prepare technical specifications, reports and project documentation.
Coordinate with multidisciplinary design teams.
Support tendering activities, site investigations and project delivery.
Carry out site inspections and prepare BCAR documentation and reports.
Complete Designer Risk Assessments and ensure health and safety compliance.
Manage project tasks in line with programme and budget requirements.
Mentor graduate engineers and technicians where appropriate.
Communicate effectively with clients, contractors and stakeholders.

About You

Level 8 Honours Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or equivalent.
Approximately 2–12 years’ relevant structural engineering experience.
Strong understanding of structural design and analysis.
Experience designing to Eurocodes across multiple construction materials.
Excellent communication, organisation and report-writing skills.
Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
Commercial awareness and understanding of project budgets and deliverables.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

For Project/Senior Engineers, Chartered Engineer status or active progress towards chartership is desirable, together with experience coordinating teams, mentoring junior engineers and engaging directly with clients.

Desirable Software

Experience with Robot, Tekla Structural Designer, CADS A3D, Tedds, AutoCAD, Revit/BIM, Civil 3D, Navisworks or construction management platforms is advantageous.

Benefits

Competitive salary, structured mentoring, professional development, chartership support, career progression, flexible working and hybrid working opportunities.

jobs.title: Land Liaison Officer
jobs.content:

Location: Mullingar, Co. Westmeath
Job Type: Specified Purpose Contract
Salary: Competitive

An established engineering and infrastructure consultancy is seeking a Land Liaison Officer to join a major road infrastructure project team based in Mullingar.

This role will involve working directly with landowners, property owners, contractors, local authorities and project teams to facilitate access, surveys, advance works and the delivery of agreed accommodation works. Approximately 7–10+ years’ relevant environmental experience.

jobs.title: Senior Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Specialist
jobs.content:
Senior Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Specialist

About the Role

An established planning and environmental consultancy is seeking an experienced Senior Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Specialist to join its growing environmental team in Ireland.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced EIA professional to lead the preparation, project management and technical quality of Environmental Impact Assessment Reports (EIARs) and supporting consenting documentation across energy, infrastructure, residential and commercial projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the preparation and authorship of EIARs in accordance with Irish and EU environmental legislation and guidance.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary inputs including ecology, hydrology, noise, traffic, landscape and visual, cultural heritage, air quality and other environmental disciplines.
  • Manage projects from inception to completion, including scope, programme, resources, budgets and profitability.
  • Lead EIARs through the Irish planning and consenting process, from scoping through to decision.
  • Coordinate junior staff, specialist consultants and sub-consultants.
  • Review technical reports and ensure high standards of quality and consistency.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, regulators, statutory bodies and project stakeholders.
  • Identify and manage project risks, deadlines and resource requirements.
  • Support business development through fee proposals, client engagement and identifying new opportunities.

jobs.title: Senior Health & Safety Consultant
jobs.content:

jobs.title: Senior Flood Risk Consultant (Flood Risk & Hydrology)
jobs.content:
Senior Flood Risk Consultant – Flood Risk & Hydrology

Location: Ireland
Level: Senior Consultant
Sector: Environmental & Engineering Consultancy

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Flood Risk Consultant to join a growing technical team. This is an excellent opportunity for a flood risk and hydrology professional looking to take greater ownership of projects, provide specialist technical expertise and work directly with clients across a diverse portfolio of development, infrastructure and environmental projects.

You will collaborate with environmental, planning and engineering specialists, providing flood risk and hydrological input from early-stage feasibility through planning, assessment and project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and manage Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) for development and infrastructure projects.
Undertake hydrological assessments and interpret catchment and flood risk data.
Support hydraulic and flood modelling activities where required.
Assess fluvial, pluvial, coastal and groundwater flood risk.
Provide technical input to EIARs, planning applications and environmental assessments.
Advise clients and multidisciplinary teams on flood risk constraints and mitigation measures.
Liaise with clients, planning authorities and relevant statutory bodies.
Review modelling outputs, technical information and third-party reports.
Manage project budgets, programmes, deadlines and technical deliverables.
Support and mentor junior team members.
Contribute to proposals, client relationships and development of flood risk services.

About You

Approximately 7–10 years’ relevant experience in flood risk, hydrology, drainage, water/environmental engineering or a related discipline.
Strong practical experience preparing Flood Risk Assessments.
Good knowledge of Irish flood risk and planning requirements.
Experience using OPW flood data and guidance and working with planning authorities.
Sound understanding of hydrological and hydraulic assessment methods.
Experience with flood modelling or confidently interpreting modelling outputs.
Strong technical report-writing and communication skills.
Proven ability to manage projects and engage with clients and multidisciplinary teams.
Relevant degree in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Hydrology, Environmental Science or a related discipline.

Consultancy experience within environmental, engineering or planning environments is particularly desirable.

Opportunity

This role offers the opportunity to take genuine ownership of projects, work across varied environmental and development schemes, combine technical expertise with project management and client engagement, and contribute to the continued development of flood risk capabilities.

The position would suit an experienced consultant seeking greater autonomy, variety and professional influence while progressing within a growing technical environment.

jobs.title: Landfill Manager
jobs.content:

Location: Cavan Region/North Midlands
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

An opportunity has arisen for an experienced environmental or waste management professional to take responsibility for the day-to-day management of an operational landfill facility in the Cavan region. The successful candidate is likely to have:

  • A degree or relevant qualification in Environmental Science, Environmental Management, Waste Management, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Previous experience within environmental management, waste management, landfill operations, wastewater treatment or another regulated industrial/site environment.
  • Strong understanding of environmental compliance and monitoring.
  • Experience working with environmental licences, permits and/or regulatory requirements.

  • Experience liaising with regulators, local authorities or other government bodies.

jobs.title: Senior Sustainability Engineer / Sustainability Lead
jobs.content:
Senior Sustainability Engineer / Sustainability Lead
Location: Clonee, Co. Dublin
Salary: €70,000–€80,000 DOE + Company Pension
Position: Full-time, Permanent, Office-Based
Please Note Before Applying

This is a full-time, office-based position in Clonee, Co. Dublin. It is not a remote or hybrid role.

Applicants must:

● Be currently based in Ireland
● Have an existing legal entitlement to work in Ireland
● Be available to work full-time from the Clonee office
● Have a minimum of 7 years’ relevant professional experience
● Have substantial practical experience with Irish Building Regulations, Non-Domestic Part L and NEAP
● Be currently qualified/registered to undertake SEAI Non-Domestic BER assessments
Employment permit sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available for this position.
Applications that do not meet the above requirements will not be considered.

The Position

A growing engineering consultancy is looking to appoint a Senior Sustainability Engineer / Sustainability
Lead to lead and develop the sustainability department within the practice.
This is a senior, hands-on position for someone with strong experience in building performance, dynamic simulation modelling and Part L compliance.
The successful candidate will work closely with the mechanical and electrical engineers and will take responsibility for sustainability input across a wide range of projects.
We are looking for someone who is technically very strong, comfortable dealing directly with clients and design teams, and capable of taking ownership of the sustainability function as it grows.
The role may suit an experienced Senior Sustainability Engineer, Building Performance Engineer or
Sustainability Consultant who is ready to take on greater responsibility and lead this area of the practice.

The Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for:
● Leading sustainability and building-performance work across projects
● Carrying out and reviewing IES VE dynamic simulation models
● Preparing Non-Domestic Part L compliance assessments
● Carrying out and issuing Non-Domestic BER assessments
● Undertaking and reviewing NEAP assessments
● Carrying out overheating, thermal comfort, natural ventilation and energy-performance studies
● Advising architects and design teams on building fabric, glazing, solar gain, air permeability and otherenergy-related design issues
● Advising on low-energy and low-carbon building design
● Assessing heat pumps, renewable-energy systems, PV and other low-carbon technologies
● Preparing energy and decarbonisation strategies for new and existing buildings
● Undertaking feasibility studies and option appraisals
● Preparing technical reports and sustainability submissions
● Attending client and design-team meetings
● Coordinating sustainability requirements with our mechanical and electrical design teams
● Reviewing project designs for compliance with energy and sustainability requirements
● Developing internal sustainability procedures, standards and QA processes
● Providing technical guidance and support to other members of the team
● Supporting and mentoring junior staff
● Helping develop and expand the sustainability services offered by the practice

Essential Requirements

Applicants should have:
● A degree in Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Sustainable Energy, Building Physics or a related discipline
● A minimum of 7 years’ relevant professional experience in sustainability, building performance, energy or building-services consultancy
● Significant experience delivering sustainability and energy assessments for projects in Ireland
● Substantial practical experience with Irish Building Regulations and the Irish building-energy regulatory ramework
● Extensive experience carrying out Part L compliance assessments for non-domestic buildings in Ireland
● Current SEAI Non-Domestic BER Assessor registration
● Excellent working knowledge of NEAP
● Expert-level competence in IES Virtual Environment (IES VE) with substantial experience developing and analysing dynamic simulation models
● Experience with complex building-performance analysis
● Strong knowledge of building physics, thermal performance, overheating, natural ventilation and
low-energy design
● Good understanding of mechanical and electrical building services and their interaction with building energy performance
● Experience working as part of multidisciplinary design teams
● Experience taking technical responsibility for projects
● Strong technical report-writing and communication skills
● Ability to manage several projects at the same time
● Confidence dealing directly with clients, architects, engineers and other consultants
● Ability to provide technical leadership and review the work of others
Previous experience supervising, mentoring or leading other staff would be advantageous, but previous experience as a formal department head is not essential.

Additional Experience

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:
● BREEAM
● LEED
● WELL
● Embodied carbon assessment
● Life-cycle assessment
● Operational energy modelling
● Building decarbonisation studies
● Energy audits
● Digital tools or automation used in building-performance analysis
Chartered Engineer status, or progress towards an appropriate professional qualification, would also be beneficial.

Leading the Sustainability Department

This role is intended for someone who can take responsibility for the sustainability function within the company.
As well as delivering project work, the successful candidate will help develop how sustainability services are delivered within the practice. This will include improving internal standards, reviewing technical quality, supporting junior staff and identifying areas where we can expand our sustainability offering.
The successful candidate will work closely with company management and will have a significant input into how the department develops.
We are also interested in making better use of digital tools, automation and AI where they can genuinely improve modelling, analysis, reporting or QA. Experience in this area would be useful but is not essential.

What We Offer

Salary of €70,000–€80,000 depending on experience
Company pension scheme
Permanent senior position
Responsibility for leading and developing the sustainability department
Direct involvement with company management
Varied project workload across education, healthcare, commercial, residential and public-sector projects
Strong client and design-team exposure
Opportunity to develop and expand the sustainability services offered by the practice
Support for continued professional development
Good long-term progression within a growing consultancy

Office based in Clonee, Co. Dublin
Apply

If you have strong experience in IES VE, Non-Domestic Part L and BER assessment and are looking for a senior role with responsibility for developing a sustainability function, we would be interested in hearing from you.
Please send your CV together with a short summary of your relevant experience in building performance, dynamic simulation modelling, Part L and Non-Domestic BER assessment.
